reuse.why: Calls the existing recurConfigToRSchedule, isDailyWeekendSkip and getDateWithSkippedWeekend from shared/schedules.ts rather than re-implementing the weekend moves or the daily-skip predicate.

duplication.why: The per-occurrence dispatch (daily skip drops weekend days, otherwise move with getDateWithSkippedWeekend when skipWeekend is on) is written a third time, after getUpcomingDates and getNextDate, instead of being one shared 'final day of an occurrence' function; the RSchedule/try/captureBreadcrumb skeleton is also repeated.

placement.why: Handler lives beside getUpcomingDates in server/schedules/app.ts and is registered like its siblings; the weekend-rule dispatch arguably belongs in shared/schedules.ts.

scope.why: Only the handler, its registration, imports and focused tests.

maintainability.why: Clear, typed and commented; a future weekend-rule change must still be mirrored in the third copy of the dispatch.

disguised_duplication.where: server/schedules/app.ts getDatesInRange restates the getUpcomingDates/getNextDate dispatch as a for-loop with an early `continue` instead of a map ternary.
